definitions.explanation: woven fabric made from cotton fibers, used for clothing, towels, and various household textiles

examples.japanese: {綿布|めんぷ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肌触|はだざわ}り→肌触り：06637_hadazawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Shirts made of cotton cloth feel good against the skin.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{綿布|めんぷ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通気性|つうきせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れている→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧。
examples.english: This cotton fabric has excellent breathability.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治時代|めいじじだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{国産|こくさん}→国産：12017_kokusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{綿布|めんぷ}⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧し、{輸出品|ゆしゅつひん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧になった。

notes:
Combines ⟦{綿|めん}→綿：03807_men⟧ (cotton) and {布|ぷ} (cloth). A somewhat formal or technical term for cotton fabric. In everyday conversation, ⟦{木綿|もめん}→木綿：01738_momen⟧ or simply コットン is more common, but {綿布|めんぷ} appears in product descriptions, historical texts, and textile industry contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {綿布|めんぷ}⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: cotton fabric products
- {綿布|めんぷ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧: cotton fabric production
- {綿布|めんぷ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{織|お}る→織る：04373_oru⟧: to weave cotton cloth
- {綿布|めんぷ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧: cotton fabric imports

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{木綿|もめん}→木綿：01738_momen⟧: cotton (fabric) — the everyday term, especially for traditional Japanese cotton
- コットン: cotton — the English loanword, commonly used in modern fashion and products
- ⟦{絹布|けんぷ}→絹布：29606_kenpu⟧: silk cloth — the silk equivalent
- {麻布|まふ}: hemp cloth; linen — fabric made from hemp fibers
